text:
maria: Quick async check-in for SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps — short format: what I did / blockers / plan. TL;DR: Go SDK quickstart shipped, sample-app needs README polish, a doc typo, CI embedding tests flaky.

sam: Reviewed Go quickstart, left a few inline comments about auth example and error handling. Suggest we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY env var. Ping @jen for sample-app config values.

jen: Merged UI tweaks for sample-app (PR #482). Still todo: add README steps for local mock server + env setup. Blocker: docker build is flaky on M1 runners (failing during pip install). Will try alternate base image today.

kevin: Working on Python SDK batching example. One question: do we explicitly show batch_size in the sample or rely on auto-batching? Currently the snippet shows explicit config. cc @maria

kevin: ```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), auto_batch=True)
resp = client.generate('Summarize this text', batch_size=8)
print(resp.text)
```

nisha: Reproduced CI failure for embeddings tests locally. Error shows CUDA OOM on our dedicated CI runners. Log snippet: ```ERROR: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory at step 12``` Tried bumping swap, still repros. Possible culprit: recent quantization change in model-config.

maria: Oof. @eng-runtime — can someone triage the quantization rollout? If this is causing CI instability we should consider a quick revert on dev cluster and unpin the change from the quickstarts until stable.

kevin: I can run a smaller repro and open an issue with exact steps. If we revert, I'll prepare the revert PR for the model-config.

sam: Also noticed the Node quickstart uses the old import path (node-redwood -> @redwood/client). I'll push a small docs fix PR to update examples and callouts.

jen: I'll add the missing README step for sample-app (how to run local mock server + sample env). Also will add an M1 note in the troubleshooting section for docker.

bot-ci: Build report: samples/sample-app build passed on 2026-03-17T09:18, but samples/embeddings failed — see CI dashboard link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7891

nisha: Thanks @bot-ci. Rerunning locally with -p 1 to isolate. Assigning follow-up to @kevin for the model-config check.

maria: Plan for today: 1) merge Sam's docs fix ASAP; 2) if embeddings OOM persists, coordinate rollback and alert eng-runtime; 3) update quickstarts index to include both Go and Python examples and add a short note about batching behavior. Ping me for any urgent reviews. :thumbsup:

sam: quick note — I'll add a short changelog entry for the quickstarts update so internal customers know about the Go sample.

jen: tagging this thread for visibility in #dev-experiences weekly sync.

kevin: will open issue + WIP PR by EOD.

maria: thanks team — keep updates concise here if anything blocks merge or CI.
